repos_data.description: Open-source AI Trading OS, agent trading, and vibe trading, with Jev System One integration. Research, build Python strategies, backtest, and paper/live trade across crypto, stocks, and forex. Launch your own multi-tenant trading SaaS with built-in user management, billing, payments, and settlement.
🚀 💸  Easily build, backtest and deploy your algo in just a few lines of code. Trade stocks, cryptos, and forex across exchanges w/ one package.
The modern cryptocurrency trading bot framework written in Go.
C#/.NET client library for the Binance.com cryptocurrency exchange REST and WebSocket APIs, supporting Spot and Futures trading and market data with strongly typed models.
A Python async and event driven framework for algorithmic trading, with a focus on crypto currencies.
AI crypto trading bot with deep neural network (84.9% accuracy, 25 coins). BiLSTM + Attention trained on GPU. Bybit, Binance, OKX, Gate.io. Free cloud or self-hosted.
PriceHub: Unified Python Package for Collecting OHLC Prices from Binance, Bybit, OKX, Coinbase, Kraken APIs into a DataFrame

Rust streaming primitives for real-time market data: exchange tick normalization (Binance, Coinbase, Alpaca, Polygon), WebSocket reconnect, lock-free SPSC ring buffer, OHLCV bars, order books, feed health and microstructure analytics (OFI, VPIN). On crates.io.
Real-time crypto pump detector for Bybit. Monitors 500+ pairs every 3s, auto-trades volume spikes with TP cascade. Open source, free.
Desktop and Android scanner for Binance USDT-M futures, with 60 technical indicators, multi-timeframe consensus and positioning analysis.
Local financial terminal with a Tauri and React interface, a Python analytics engine, market scanners, portfolio tools and optional broker connections.
MCP server for crypto portfolio tracking. No dashboard UI — AI hosts render on demand. Bybit, Binance, MetaMask, Solana, Polymarket.
The Cognitive Market Brain for Autonomous AI Trading Agents (Level 4 Cortex, Orderflow Physics & Contradiction Engine).
Usenami Signer MCP — sign CEX/DEX orders (Binance, OKX, Asterdex) from any MCP-aware AI agent; the signing key never leaves an AWS Nitro Enclave (attested PCR0). 5 tools, stdio.
Async Python connector for Binance SPOT FIX testing, latency research, and feed/session comparison
